archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 wrapper ownership moved from detach sidecars to bgjob registry and result envs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed Step 5 review and resume wrappers for bgjob ownership correctness. Focus on fresh-start truncation, live-registry rejoin, child KV publication into merge-result envs, and owner-death/orphan delegation. Check that terminal sentinels are preserved without letting sentinels or launcher stdout authorize continuation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
